repository.name: MarketOS
repository.scope: documentation-only inventory; no application or runtime configuration
repository.default_policy: offline, no credentials, no provider calls, no external mutations

state_rules.installed_local_presence: the executable or cache exists; it does not prove configuration, authentication, reachability, or execution
state_rules.configured: only record when a non-secret configuration surface was verified; private account values and credentials are never inspected
state_rules.proposed_not_installed: an official or reviewed reference exists but no local installation was observed
state_rules.unavailable: the named command or repository surface was not present
state_rules.reference_only: documented for architecture/provenance review and not enabled as a MarketOS authority
state_rules.defer: not approved for the current offline default; reconsider only with an explicit scoped review
state_rules.reject: incompatible with the current authority or safety boundary

skills.name: Everything Claude Code (ECC) skills
permissions: read local repository files
write only when explicitly authorized by the host
skills.model_usage: skill instructions only; model/provider cost is host-dependent and not inferred
risks: large third-party instruction surface
unreviewed skill changes could alter agent behavior
local cache has no verified Git commit pin
skills.cross_platform: content is portable; command/runtime behavior varies by host
skills.rollback: disable the ECC plugin/cache entry at the host; do not delete shared caches from this repository task

skills.name: gstack workflow adaptation skills
permissions: read repository context
write only through explicitly invoked workflows
skills.model_usage: workflow instructions; native gstack runtime is not installed
risks: adaptation can drift from upstream
workflow prompts can broaden scope if not reviewed
skills.cross_platform: portable skill files; native browser/device workflows are host-dependent
skills.rollback: disable the cached plugin; restore prior host plugin selection

skills.name: CoderOS operator contract
permissions: read-only probe/health/snapshot when explicitly invoked
skills.model_usage: local control-plane metadata only; no model call performed
risks: must not be imported into MarketOS
CoderOS workspace itself is separately dirty and frozen for this task
skills.cross_platform: Python CLI contract; host paths and optional tools vary
skills.rollback: remove the host skill reference; MarketOS has no runtime dependency on CoderOS

skills.name: Codex system-managed skills
permissions: host-managed; no MarketOS installation permission granted
skills.model_usage: may use configured paid or local models; this manifest does not select a model
risks: host updates are outside Git revision control
system skills are not application authorities
skills.rollback: use host plugin/skill controls; no repository rollback is required

plugins.name: Codex app tools
permissions: Codex app-managed UI/tool access
per-tool authorization
plugins.model_usage: host/account dependent; paid versus local is not asserted
risks: MCP tools can expose files or external systems
tool permissions must remain per-task and narrow
plugins.cross_platform: Codex desktop host surface; bundled paths are platform-specific
plugins.rollback: disable/unselect the app plugin in Codex; do not edit MarketOS

plugins.name: Claude Code official plugins
permissions: would require explicit workspace and possibly account authorization
plugins.model_usage: paid or subscription service; no account or model was inspected
risks: plugins may configure MCP servers
credentials and external actions require separate review
plugins.cross_platform: Claude Code supports Windows through documented host layers; exact plugin support varies
plugins.rollback: do not install; if later approved, remove the exact plugin and its scoped MCP configuration

plugins.name: Gemini CLI extensions
permissions: extension installation
possible MCP/server and shell permissions
plugins.model_usage: Google service or configured model; cost is account-dependent
risks: installation copies extension content into the user profile
extension MCP and shell tools can broaden authority
plugins.cross_platform: CLI documentation covers Windows/macOS/Linux; extension contents remain platform-dependent
plugins.rollback: run the documented extension uninstall/disable operation for the exact extension; remove no shared files here

connectors.name: GitHub CLI
permissions: explicit GitHub CLI operations only; repository and PR scope is command-dependent
risks: GitHub credentials and write operations are host/account dependent
this is the sole GitHub authority; no second GitHub connector is added
connectors.cross_platform: Windows/macOS/Linux supported by the official CLI
connectors.rollback: disable or uninstall GitHub CLI through its package manager; revoke account authorization separately if needed

connectors.name: Official Model Context Protocol Registry
permissions: none in MarketOS; discovery only
risks: registry discovery does not establish server safety
each server needs independent provenance, permissions, and license review
connectors.rollback: remove any future registry reference; no local installation exists

connectors.name: Render official MCP server/plugin

source.license: service/project terms; verify implementation revision before use

permissions: OAuth or API key
Render workspace/resource access
connectors.model_usage: host/model dependent; external service use may incur account cost
risks: supports deploys, environment changes, service/database creation, logs, and metrics
could expose secrets or production resources
connectors.cross_platform: hosted MCP is broadly reachable; client setup differs by platform

connectors.name: OpenRouter official skills

source.license: verify repository and each skill before adoption

permissions: would require project/user skill installation
API key for model calls
connectors.model_usage: paid or free-tier routed models; usage and provider selection are account-dependent

API keys and provider data require separate approval

mcp_servers.name: Render hosted MCP server

source.license: service terms; implementation license requires separate review

permissions: Render OAuth/API key and workspace/resource permissions
risks: deploy, environment, database, and service mutations are supported
secrets and production telemetry may enter model context

mcp_servers.rollback: do not configure; if enabled later, revoke authorization and remove the scoped MCP entry

allowed_without_additional_approval: local deterministic model use with no credentials or provider calls
requires_explicit_approval: deployment, publishing, payment, order, message, ad, or CRM action
rejected_patterns: treating CoderOS as a MarketOS runtime dependency
treating installed command presence as authenticated or operational evidence

model_cost_policy.local_free: Ollama may be used only when explicitly selected and offline-safe
model_cost_policy.paid_or_hosted: Codex, Claude, Gemini, Jules, Grok, and OpenRouter may incur account or provider cost; no account state was inspected
model_cost_policy.evidence_rule: model availability or command presence is not evidence that a provider call executed

source_integrity_notes: A local cache version is not a Git revision. Missing or unverified revisions remain null and are never replaced with moving branch names.
Historical MarketOS source-adaptation records containing synthetic-looking revisions for CoderOS, Hermes, or gstack are not accepted as source pins by this manifest.
A license label applies only to the source item and exact revision identified; hosted services, plugins, and individual MCP servers require separate terms/license review.
No credentials, private account settings, environment files, client data, raw logs, provider payloads, or external mutations were inspected or stored.

rollback.repository_change: revert the single documentation commit or remove the two manifest files; no application code or host configuration is changed
